_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Nan gaw Golf (Lahkam Hkrai) hkam la - Lahkru {player_id}.
Hpung: Rai hkam shi hkrai shi hku shi hpe hkan hkam sha rai hku hkra. Lahkam shi hku shi gaw rai hku hkra yang, shi hku shi gaw 0 hkra.
Lahkam Hkrai hpung: A=1, 2-10=hkrai hpung, J/Q=10, K=0

Hkam la (hkrai hte hku hkam sha yu yu):
- '[draw]' - Hkrai hkam sha deck hkrai
- '[take]' - Hkrai hkam sha lahkam hkrai hku
- '[swap X Y]' - Hkrai hkam sha lahkam hkrai X (hkrai) Y (hkrai) hku hkam sha
- '[discard]' - Hkrai hkam sha lahkam hkrai hku hkam sha yu

board.drew:
Nang pawt ai: {card}
Nang must [swap X Y] amyu [discard] ai.
board.took:
Nang tsun ai: {card} kasha tsun hpun kaw
Na kasha [swap X Y] shangun ra ai (kasha tsun hkan n ra ai).

options.final_turns: Final turns! Nang options: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.draw: Na a lata la mai ai lam ni gaw: [draw], [take]
options.must_swap: Nang gaw: [swap X Y] (hkum kau ai hta na card ni hpe n kabai kau lu)
options.swap_or_discard: Nang gaw: [swap X Y] or [discard] hpe ra ai.

hand.no_cards: Hkaw tsun ladat ni n nga ai.

action_desc.swapped: Miwa {pid} kasha {new} hte {old} shangun ai ({row},{col}) kaw

message.deck_empty: Hpakant hta hpa mung n nga sai. Dai ginsup poi gaw kalang ta htum mat ai.
message.knocked: Miwa {pid} kasha shangun ai! Miwa mungdan kasha shangai wa hte shangun ra ai.
message.final_round: Miwa {pid} {reason}! Miwa mungdan kasha shangai wa hte shangun ra ai.

invalid.wrong_action: Use exactly ONE bracketed action: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], amyu [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Hprawng kau ai arung arai ni gaw n nga sai!
invalid.must_draw_first: Nan hkan [draw], [take], [knock], hkam [peek X Y] sha rai hkrai.
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Hkum di kau ai hta na lata la wa ai laika hpe n kabai kau lu ai. Dai hpe galai ra ai.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Nanhte a lam the e kaji hkam la. Nanhte [swap X Y] kanau [discard] hkam ra.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Dai hpe galai na matu, lata da ai laika buk ra ai.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Dai hpe kabai kau na matu, lata da ai laika buk ra nga ai.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Position out of bounds. Use row 1-{max_row}, column 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Nang gaw, nang hpe jaw da ai laika hte n mai htu sai. Shawng nnan na a hkringdat ngut u.
invalid.already_knocked: Ndai lang na zuphpawng hta marai langai ngai gaw shang lawm wa sai.
invalid.already_revealed: Dai sumla gaw madun da ngut sai.

board_str.title: GOLF GAMING hpe galaw u. (sh) Hkaw tsun ladat ni hte madun u.
